title: Learning to Judge: LLMs Designing and Applying Evaluation Rubrics

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the alignment, reliability, and cross-model transferability of LLM-generated evaluation rubrics to reveal idiosyncratic 'evaluation dialects' and inconsistencies across different model architectures.
Calculating the normalized score differences (deltas) between LLM-assigned evaluation scores and human ground-truth scores across multiple text generation datasets in a zero-shot setting.
